title: RegistrationLeafDocument
description: A standalone registration leaf document for a specific package version.

@id.description: The URL to the registration leaf.

catalogEntry.description: The URL to the catalog entry that produced this leaf.

listed.description: Whether the package is listed. Considered listed if absent.

packageContent.description: The URL to the package content (.nupkg).

published.description: An ISO 8601 timestamp of when the package was published. Set to year 1900 on nuget.org when the package is unlisted.

registration.description: The URL to the registration index.
